arabic text: Sadkaa nikaal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
Chadar chinenge jis dam tab kon paas honga. Qaydi banenge jab ham tab kon paas honga.\nMat kar sawaal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: When the veils are snatched, who will remain beside us? When we are made captives, who will remain beside us?\nDo not ask this question, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Maktal mein kho na jaye ghazi ke baad bache. Be haal ho na jaye ghazi ke baad bache.\nRakhna khayaal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: After Ghazi, may the children not become lost in the battlefield; after Ghazi, may they not be left helpless\nTake care of them, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Pardesi me chinengi ab tere sar se chadar. Ab baal khol apne ay bibi apne sar par. Ab\nkhaak daal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: In this foreign land, your chadar will now be snatched from your head; O Lady, scatter your hair upon your head\nNow cast dust upon yourself, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Bacho se ab tamache ay bibiyo lagenge. Shame ghariban hongi khayme bhi ab jalenge.\nRakhde zawaal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: O ladies, the children will now be struck; the night of the bereaved will come and the tents will burn\nAccept this decline, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Koi khaak par khare tad gash khaa ke gir raha hai. Be haal koi ho kar takra ke ghir raha\nhai. Sabko sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: Someone stands upon the dust and falls unconscious; another, overwhelmed, collides and falls\nSteady everyone, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Sheh reh gaye hai tanha koi nahi hai zainab. Gazi ke baad sheh ka koi nahi hai zainab.\nSheh ka khayal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: The King has been left alone; no one remains, Zainab. After Ghazi, the King has no one, Zainab\nTake care of the King, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Ghazi ke gird phir kar aa chal ki tu hawaa de. Shaano pe haat rak kar ghazi ko tu duwaa\nde. Hai pur jalaal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai\nChadar sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: Circle around Ghazi and fan him with the air; place your hand upon his shoulders and pray for him\nHe is majestic, Zainab—Abbas is departing\nHold fast to your chadar, Zainab—Abbas is departing

arabic text: Khayme me thaam kar dil kahi aa na jaye sarwar. Sunkar ye bayn tere gash kha na jaaye\nsarwar. Khud ko sambhal zainab abbas jaa rahe hai
english translation text: Hold your heart within the tent, lest Sarwar come; hearing your lament, may Sarwar not faint\nSteady yourself, Zainab—Abbas is departing
